metadata.title: Verification code for generic local and global identifiability in linear networks
metadata.description:
Companion verification code for the manuscript Generic Local Identifiability Does Not Imply Generic Global Identifiability in Linear Networks, by Anders Hansson.

The archive reconstructs the six-node and twelve-node examples, verifies the rational involution and its domain, checks equality of transfer matrices, certifies exact matrix-power bounds, and computes Jacobian ranks with respect to all 42 independent edge positions. It includes nonsymmetric checks, a pair with exactly one spectrally admissible member, and the reduced-Jacobian conditioning identity.

Dependencies, usage instructions, exact JSON outputs, a file manifest, and an MIT license are included. The arithmetic checks support the analytical proofs; they do not assert genericity for arbitrary prescribed dynamic orders or strictly proper networks. OpenAI Codex assisted with the construction, verification code, and documentation.
